scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:next: concurrently -n server,next -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix next-client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.capacitor:sync: npm run build --prefix next-client && npm run cap:sync --prefix next-client
scripts.cordova:prepare: npm run build --prefix next-client && node next-client/scripts/copy-to-cordova.mjs
scripts.cordova:build: npm run cordova:prepare && npx cordova build --project-dir mobile/cordova
